description: Paid: 0.001 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.001 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). Pay per call, solves one question: What is the ISO 639 code row for this language code or exact language name? One row of the ISO 639-3 code table published by SIL Global (with its ISO 639-2 and ISO 639-1 identifiers, scope and type) for one 2- or 3-letter code or one exact reference name, from a bundled snapshot dated 2026-10-15. Source: iso639-3.sil.org; identifiers unmodified. One lookup per call; no list or bulk download. A code reading, not a statement about any language. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

code.description: ISO 639-1, 639-2 or 639-3 code, e.g. de, ger, deu (give code or name)

name.description: exact ISO 639-3 reference name, e.g. German

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.

name: language_code
title: ISO 639 language code lookup (paid: 0.001 RLUSD / 0.001 USDC on Base / 0.001 RLUSD on Base via x402)
